basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Bastar Jagdalpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 16 Accountant, Programme Officer and More Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The age of the candidate must be between 21 years and 40 years as on 01.01.2026. Upper age limit relaxations apply as per General Administration Department rules from time to time for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories.

qualification.details: Candidates must be local residents of Chhattisgarh.

selection_process: The selection process is based on a merit list determined by marks obtained in the qualifying examination
and experience in government rural development schemes.
Programme Officer: 70 marks for percentage obtained in minimum educational qualification
and 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes (5 marks per year up to 3 years). Assistant Programmer: 45 marks for percentage obtained in minimum educational qualification
40 marks for merit in computer practical test (mandatory minimum 60 marks required in computer practical test out of 100)
and 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes (5 marks per year up to 3 years). Accountant: 20 marks for percentage obtained in Higher Secondary
50 marks for percentage obtained in minimum educational qualification
and 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes (5 marks per year up to 3 years).
how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification PDF from the official website.
Fill out the application form completely with correct details.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all required educational, residential, caste, and experience certificates along with valid employment exchange registration card.
Enclose the application in a 9x4 inch self-addressed envelope affixed with Rs. 40/- postal stamps.
Submit the application form in person or send it via registered or speed post to the Office of Zila Panchayat Bastar, Jagdalpur (Chhattisgarh).
Ensure the application reaches on or before 30 October 2026 by 05:30 PM.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted separately for each post if applying for multiple posts. The age limit is calculated as on 01 January 2026. Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date (30 October 2026, 05:30 PM) will be summarily rejected. Experience will only be considered if gained in government rural development schemes with identical or equal pay scales. Candidates currently working in government schemes must enclose a No Objection Certificate and leave application details along with order copies. The appointment is purely on a contract basis for one year under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (VB-G RAM G). The number of vacancies is subject to change as per administrative requirements.

content_sections.text: The selection process is based on a merit list determined by marks obtained in the qualifying examination, weightage for computer practical test, and experience in government rural development schemes. Programme Officer: 70 marks for percentage obtained in minimum educational qualification, 15 marks for computer practical test, and 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes (5 marks per year up to 3 years). Assistant Programmer: 45 marks for percentage obtained in minimum educational qualification, 40 marks for merit in computer practical test (mandatory minimum 60 marks required in computer practical test out of 100), and 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes (5 marks per year up to 3 years). Accountant: 20 marks for percentage obtained in Higher Secondary, 50 marks for percentage obtained in minimum educational qualification, 15 marks for computer practical test, and 15 marks for experience in government rural development schemes (5 marks per year up to 3 years).
